name: Sign in, set up an artist workspace, and keep a release private
covers: durable profile and Song Passport reads
description: Verifies an authenticated artist can save private career details and a release, reload the workspace, and see only their own records.
steps: Open NOTE while signed out and confirm the workspace requires sign-in
Sign in as Actor A
Create an artist profile with a name, genre, home territory NL, language English, and territory NL
Create a Single release with title 'Quiet Harbour', language English, territory NL, and authority confirmation unchecked
Refresh the page and verify the artist profile and 'Quiet Harbour' are still present
Sign out as Actor A and sign in as Actor B with a separate test account
Verify Actor B has no profile or 'Quiet Harbour' release from Actor A
expected: Actor A's records remain after refresh and are absent from Actor B's private workspace.

name: Set campaign boundaries before marking a campaign active
description: Verifies campaign boundaries and release authority are reviewed before activation, and all state changes remain artist controlled.
setup: Sign in and create an artist profile with territory NL and language English
Create a Single release named 'Quiet Harbour' in territory NL with language English and leave authority confirmation unchecked
steps: Create a campaign for 'Quiet Harbour' with a specific objective, future start and end dates, Press and Radio channels, NL territory, English language, a EUR budget cap, and explicit exclusions
Add campaign copy containing only known release details, review its facts and rights, and save it
Mark the campaign Ready
Choose Mark active and verify NOTE blocks activation until release authority is confirmed
Edit the release and confirm authority to promote it
Mark the campaign Active
Open Song Passport, edit the release, uncheck authority confirmation, and verify NOTE blocks the save while its campaign is active
Cancel and reopen the release to verify authority remains confirmed, then Pause the campaign, resume it, and mark it Completed
Refresh and verify the campaign remains Completed
Archive the release and verify it remains in history while being unavailable for a new campaign
expected: The campaign cannot be marked Active before authority and boundaries are confirmed; reviewed copy and campaign history persist. NOTE sends no external actions.

name: Vet an opportunity, record artist-run activity, and suppress contact
description: Verifies an artist can keep a source and fee note, log only work they performed, and make a permanent do-not-contact decision.
setup: Sign in and create an artist profile with territory NL and language English
Create a Single release named 'Quiet Harbour' in NL with authority confirmed
Create a campaign for that release with dates, a Press channel, NL territory, English language, a EUR budget cap, and exclusions
steps: Add an opportunity called 'North Sea Sessions' with a real HTTPS public page, Press channel, NL territory, a fit reason, public submission route, fee disclosure 'Free', and mark current rules reviewed
Create an activity record for the campaign and opportunity with event 'Sent by artist', today's date, and a short factual note
Edit the activity note and verify the changed note is visible
Use Do not contact for 'North Sea Sessions' and enter a reason
Refresh and verify the opportunity is marked Do not contact and no longer appears as an option for new activity
Delete the activity record and verify it is absent after refresh
expected: The opportunity stays recorded as suppressed, the activity log accurately reflects only saved manual entries, and removed activity remains absent after refresh.

name: Import a royalty statement, reconcile by release, and export records
description: Verifies source data can be entered or imported, tied to a release, and exported with provenance while larger collections remain paginated.
setup: Sign in and create an artist profile with territory NL and language English
Create a Single release named 'Quiet Harbour' with ISRC 'NLABC2600001', language English, and territory NL
steps: Choose a CSV statement with headers ISRC, Amount, Currency, Statement date, Period, Category, Source and 100 distinct statement lines for 'NLABC2600001'; map the columns, use reference 'CSV-Q1-2026', and import
Verify the ledger shows the statement source and imported artist statement provenance
Import the exact same 100-line CSV again and verify the matching rows are skipped rather than added twice

Add an artist-entered income record for 'Quiet Harbour' with source 'Example Distributor', category 'Master royalties', period '2026 Q1', date '2026-04-15', amount 2.50, currency EUR, and statement reference 'Q1-2026'
Edit the manual record to amount 2.75 and verify the revised amount is shown
Load more income records and verify the additional page appears
Open Settings and download the complete workspace JSON export
expected: The imported statement lines retain source and provenance, the exact repeat is skipped, the manual entry is editable, the next page loads, and a complete JSON export downloads.

name: Export and permanently delete NOTE data from a phone-sized screen
covers: auth account remains after NOTE data deletion
description: Verifies the mobile workspace can be exported and all NOTE records can be permanently removed through explicit confirmation without deleting the sign-in account.
steps: Sign in to a test workspace with an artist profile, one release, one campaign, one opportunity, one activity record, and one income line
Open the mobile navigation and use Settings to download the workspace export
Choose Delete all NOTE data and enter the exact confirmation 'DELETE MY NOTE DATA'
Verify NOTE reports completion and the workspace contains no profile, releases, campaigns, opportunities, activity, or income records
Refresh and verify the workspace remains empty while the account stays signed in
expected: All NOTE records are gone after refresh, the sign-in account remains active, and the mobile layout completes the export and deletion flows.
